title: Flow Vibing: every prototype is also a flow
bodyText: A canvas tool I built where the prototype and the flow chart are the same artifact. It opens with the gap I found in a previous redesign challenge: designers work spatially, but AI tools iterate in a chat thread. Then five steps through the real interface, using a recovery-tracking app as the worked example.
whatThisProves: I take a gap I found in one redesign challenge and build the answer far enough to show the real interface doing the work.
